text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, I have suffered 
another blunder...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I worked hard believing next time would 
be my chance, but once again, I fell 
short..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Guh...! Just how inexperienced am I...?!
choice_data_list:
Our greatest enemy is the weakness in our 
own hearts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
First, take the time to build up my 
strength, is that what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, I was getting a little ahead of 
myself. Everyone else has been working 
hard too, after all. There is no way 
winning would be easy...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was able to realize something important. 
Undeterred by the race results, I shall 
forge ahead!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...You are quite right. While I am 
faltering, the gap between me and the 
others will only widen further.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Now is the time to grit your teeth and 
dedicate yourself to training!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. My eyes have been opened. I 
shall devote myself so I never lose my way 
again!
